generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed at leaset 50 % of this contract as as prime contractor of same works not less than Rs 50% of tender amount (work done certificate is issued by DCF Or any Other Equalant District level Officer only)
For address proof any copy of Adhar Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Adhar Card, Voter ID and Ration Card and Bank Pass book and ID issued any Corporation TP to be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate.
Annual turnover details For Last three Financial year (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) Upload turnover certificate certified by Charted Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Contractor should be registered as PWD contract Regestration (Class-I, II, III, IV) and Forest Contractor in forest department for the year 2026-27
Income tax return filed documents for the year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 to be enclosed
A copy of GST Number Registered under GST act
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Details of goods carriage vehicle and labor service and list of machineries and materials and equipments owned by the contractor.
Others -- Photo Copy of PAN Card.

technicalCriterionList.description: Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
